name: Eephus Growth Fund II

terms.couponNote: Tiered by share class, set by how much you invest, and the ladder is NOT the same as Fund I. A-1 ($1M+) 9%, A-2 ($500k+) 8%, A-3 ($250k+) 8%, A-4 ($100k+) 7%, A-5 ($50k+) 6%. Annualised and non-compounding, on Unreturned Capital Value.
terms.couponAccrual: Accrues from the LATER of the date you fund or the date the Company deploys your contribution. Contributions made on different dates accrue separately.
terms.mgmtFeeNote: 2% of effective gross income from the properties, paid monthly. On income, not on committed capital.
terms.carry: 30% catch-up to Class B, then 70/30 to a 15% IRR, then 50/50
terms.carryNote: Preferred returns first, with 30% of those distributions credited to a Class B catch-up account; then Class B until the catch-up is cleared; then 70/30 until Class A reach a 15% IRR; then 50/50.

liquidity.source: Expected sell-down; fund winds up after

structure: Second vintage of the Eephus real estate fund. Same structure as Fund I.
_about: Global deal facts only. Terms are identical for everyone who bought the same deal, so they live here rather than being retyped by each holder. Nothing personal is in this file: your commitment, funding dates, thesis and notes stay in your own tracker and never leave your machine.
source: Private Placement Memorandum and Operating Agreement of Eephus Growth Fund II, LLC dated 30 Dec 2025, plus the Class A-5 subscription agreement and the 506(c) business plan.
variesNote: Your preferred rate is set by how much you invested, and the tool now works your class out from your commitment. Fund II runs a finer ladder than Fund I and pays 9% at the top: 9% from $1M, 8% from $250k, 7% from $100k, 6% from $50k.

tiers.source: PPM, Offering Structure table and the Preferred Return definition: units are $1,000 each and each class states a minimum unit count.
